summary: Delivered the memos OLD-VITE-ORIGIN migration cell. New reusable react-vite-origin-adapter (era build-target pinning, analyzer-driven config planning that refuses unknown options/plugins pre-build, removed-client-API restoration, preprocessor resolution), exported and covered by 30 tests; overfitting guard extended with 'memos'. Era baseline lane (vite 2.9.5, Node 16.20.2, frozen lockfile, tsc-gate deviation carried with its label) and migrated lane (vite 8.0.16) each rebuild byte-identically; applicationFilesChanged is 0 of 120 src files. Build-parity evidence written. Fixed a real defect: .tsx parsed as JS caused a false refusal. tsc, lint (0 errors), and 1325 tests pass. No network needed; all builds offline.
open_questions: The consented Vite 8 target closure install was not needed and not performed: the migrated lane reuses the era lockfile-pinned dependency tree unchanged, with only the bundler moving. Recorded in the evidence as a finding; confirm the cockpit is content that VL-LEGACY-CORPUS-2026-08-10's network allowance went unused rather than being spent to install a fresh closure.

The migrated lane omits @vitejs/plugin-react entirely (Vite 8 performs the JSX transform itself from tsconfig jsx: react-jsx). The current plugin was not installed or exercised, so Fast Refresh and the plugin's dev-only half are unestablished; the omission is recorded as a material declared difference scoped to the production build.
